title: Sermons
lead: Sunday messages: a text, the passages, a YouTube video and links (for example the audio on Google Drive). Nothing is required except the title.
empty_p: Add the first: a title is enough, the rest can come later.
title_ph: The title shown on the site
summary_ph: One or two sentences for the list and shares.
transcript_help: If someone wrote the sermon down. One language only.
en_note: Optional. Without English, English-speaking visitors see French with a note.
preacher_help: The name only shows on the site if the person agreed.
preacher_consent: This person agreed to have their name shown on the site
passages_help: Louis Segond 1910 for French, World English Bible for English. Only the references are shown.
video_ph: Paste the video address (youtube.com or youtu.be)
video_help: Optional. The video only loads when someone plays it.
video_bad: This is not a YouTube video address.
links_help: Optional. For example the audio on Google Drive (shared with “Anyone with the link”). The site hosts nothing: it opens the link.
link_bad: The address must start with https://
side_slug_help: Created automatically from the title, always unique; it no longer changes once the sermon is published.
preview_help: A secret link, valid for 3 days, to show the draft to someone without an account.
delete_p: This is permanent, including earlier versions. Archiving is often enough.
archive_p: It leaves the site but stays here.
unpublish_p: It goes back to a draft.
series_lead: Group sermons that follow one another. A series only shows on the site if it holds a published sermon.
series_empty_p: Create one when several sermons follow each other.
series_delete_p: The sermons stay, without a series.

site.empty_p: As soon as a sermon is published you will find it here: text, passages, video and links to listen.
site.empty_filter_p: Try another filter, or show all sermons.
site.not_found_p: It may have been taken down or its address changed.
site.preview_banner: Preview: this sermon is not public yet.
site.video_note: The video loads from YouTube when you start it.
site.fallback: This sermon is not translated yet: here is the French version.

sunday_help: Optional. If this sermon was (or will be) preached on a Sunday prepared in “Liturgie”, link it to that Sunday: you can then take its date, readings and preacher. You can pick a past or an upcoming Sunday.
sunday_empty: This Sunday is not prepared in “Liturgie” yet.
sunday_copy_help: Only fills what is still empty (date, passages, preacher). The agreement to show a name is never copied.
